question: Name the capital of Uganda?A. MogadishuB. KampalaC. LusakaD. Bulenga (RRB NTPC Tier I (03/04/2016) Shift 1)
options: C
A
B
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Kampala

Explanation:
Uganda is a country in East Africa, and its capital is Kampala. Located on the northern shores of Lake Victoria, it is the largest city and economic hub of Uganda. Kampala is also known as the 'City of Seven Hills'. Mogadishu is the capital of Somalia, Lusaka is the capital of Zambia, and Bulenga is a suburban area in Uganda, not the capital.

question_hi: युगांडा की राजधानी का नाम बताइए?A. मोगादिशुB. कंपाला C. लुसाकाD. बुलेंगा (RRB NTPC Tier I (03/04/2016) Shift 1)

question: What is ' Planet Nine'?A. Planet in the Comet GalaxyB. A planet in Andromeda GalaxyC. A planet where the 'Star Wars' series took placeD. A large icy planet proposed in the outer Solar System (RRB NTPC Tier I (03/04/2016) Shift 1)
options: D
A
B
C
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is A large icy planet proposed in the outer Solar System

Explanation:
'Planet Nine' is a hypothetical planet proposed to orbit in the outer Solar System beyond Neptune. It is a large icy planet with a mass about 10 times that of Earth. Its existence is inferred from the unusual orbits of distant Kuiper Belt objects. Astronomers Konstantin Batygin and Mike Brown proposed it in 2016. Planet Nine has not been directly observed, but its gravitational influence suggests its presence. It is believed to be a super-Earth type planet, composed mainly of rock and ice. Its predicted orbital period is around 10,000 to 20,000 years.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Where is Planet Nine proposed to be located? → Outer Solar System beyond Neptune
☛ What is the estimated mass of Planet Nine? → About 10 Earth masses
☛ Who proposed Planet Nine? → Batygin and Brown (2016)
☛ How is Planet Nine detected? → Through its gravitational effects
☛ What type of planet is Planet Nine? → Icy planet

Explanation:
'प्लैनेट नाइन' एक काल्पनिक ग्रह है जिसे बाहरी सौर मंडल में नेपच्यून से परे परिक्रमा करने का प्रस्ताव दिया गया है। यह एक बड़ा बर्फीला ग्रह है जिसका द्रव्यमान पृथ्वी से लगभग 10 गुना है। इसके अस्तित्व का अनुमान दूरस्थ कुइपर बेल्ट की वस्तुओं की असामान्य कक्षाओं से लगाया गया है। खगोलशास्त्री कॉन्स्टेंटिन बैटीगिन और माइक ब्राउन ने 2016 में इसका प्रस्ताव रखा था। प्लैनेट नाइन को अभी तक प्रत्यक्ष रूप से नहीं देखा गया है, लेकिन इसके गुरुत्वाकर्षण प्रभाव से इसकी उपस्थिति का संकेत मिलता है।

question: Indian currency notes are printed in which place?A. New DelhiB. BombayC. NashikD. Agra (RRB NTPC Tier I (03/04/2016) Shift 1)
options: C
B
D
A
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Nashik

Explanation:
In India, currency notes are issued by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), but their printing is done by government-owned companies: Bharatiya Reserve Bank Note Mudran Private Limited (BRBNMPL) and Security Printing and Minting Corporation of India Limited (SPMCIL). The major printing presses are located in Nashik (Maharashtra), Dewas (Madhya Pradesh), Salboni (West Bengal), and Mysuru (Karnataka). The India Security Press in Nashik, under SPMCIL, is the oldest and most prominent note-printing facility. Other options like New Delhi, Bombay, and Agra do not have any currency printing press.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Oldest note printing press in India → Nashik (India Security Press)
☛ Main agencies for note printing → SPMCIL and BRBNMPL
☛ Press located in Dewas → Bank Note Press, Dewas
☛ Salboni press is in which state → West Bengal
☛ Mysuru press belongs to → BRBNMPL
question_hi: भारतीय मुद्रा नोट किस स्थान पर छापे जाते हैं? A. नई दिल्लीB. बॉम्बेC. नासिक D. आगरा (RRB NTPC Tier I (03/04/2016) Shift 1)

question: What is the Siberian ibex?A. Mountain LionsB. Large and heavily built goatsC. Mountain DeerD. A Type of Horse (RRB NTPC Tier I (03/04/2016) Shift 1)
options: B
C
A
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Large and heavily built goats

Explanation:
The Siberian ibex (Capra sibirica) is a species of wild goat found in the mountainous regions of Central Asia. It is known for its large size and heavy build, with males having long, curved horns. It primarily inhabits high-altitude areas of the Altai, Himalayas, and Tibet. Its diet consists of grasses, leaves, and shrubs. This species is famous for its robust body structure and ability to climb steep cliffs.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Scientific name of Siberian ibex → Capra sibirica
☛ Natural habitat → High mountain regions of Central Asia
☛ Key feature → Large and heavily built wild goat
☛ Male horns → Long and curved
☛ Conservation status → Near Threatened (IUCN Red List)
question_hi: साइबेरियाई आइबेक्स क्या है?A. पर्वतीय शेरB. बड़ी और भारी बकरियाँC. पर्वतीय हिरणD. घोड़े का एक नस्ल (RRB NTPC Tier I (03/04/2016) Shift 1)

साइबेरियाई आइबेक्स (Capra sibirica) एक जंगली बकरी की प्रजाति है जो मध्य एशिया के पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों में पाई जाती है। यह अपने बड़े आकार और भारी शरीर के लिए जानी जाती है, जिसमें नर के लंबे, घुमावदार सींग होते हैं। यह मुख्यतः अल्ताई, हिमालय और तिब्बत के ऊंचे क्षेत्रों में निवास करती है। इसका आहार घास, पत्तियों और झाड़ियों पर आधारित होता है। यह प्रजाति अपनी मजबूत शारीरिक संरचना और खड़ी चट्टानों पर चढ़ने की क्षमता के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

question: What is Swadeshi?A. Made in India, from materials that have also been produced in IndiaB. Made in Foreign Lands from materials that are foreignC. A Charkha that is used to cotton woolD. A Country Flag that is made of Cotton (RRB NTPC Tier I (03/04/2016) Shift 1)
options: B
D
C
A
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Option A

Explanation:
Swadeshi means 'of one's own country' or 'made in one's own country'. It was an economic philosophy propagated by Mahatma Gandhi during the Indian independence movement. It emphasized the use of Indian goods and boycott of foreign goods. Swadeshi involves manufacturing goods using materials that are locally produced. It promotes self-reliance and supports local industries. The charkha became a symbol of the Swadeshi movement, but Swadeshi is not limited to the charkha or flag. Option A is the most accurate definition.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ What is the literal meaning of Swadeshi? → Of one's own country
☛ What is a major symbol associated with the Swadeshi movement? → Charkha
☛ Which item was boycotted during the Swadeshi movement? → Foreign cloth
☛ What was the objective of Swadeshi? → To promote self-reliance and local industries
question_hi: स्वदेशी क्या है?A. मेड इन इंडिया, उन सामग्रियों से जो भारत में भी उत्पादित की गई हैं।B. उन सामग्रियों से विदेशी भूमि में उत्पादित होती हैं। C. एक चरखा जो कपास ऊन को घुमाने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है।D. एक देश का झंडा जो कपास से बना है। (RRB NTPC Tier I (03/04/2016) Shift 1)

Explanation:

question: What was the code name of the nuclear tests conducted by India in Pokhran in 1998?A. Operation Desert stormB. Operation VijayC. Operation ShaktiD. Operation Kaboom (RRB NTPC Tier I (03/04/2016) Shift 1)
options: A
C
B
D
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Operation Shakti

Explanation:
The code name of the nuclear tests conducted by India in Pokhran in 1998 was Operation Shakti. The tests were carried out on 11 and 13 May 1998 at the Pokhran test range in Rajasthan, involving five nuclear explosions. This made India a nuclear weapons state. The tests were conducted under the leadership of Prime Minister Atal Bihari Vajpayee. Following Operation Shakti, India declared itself a nuclear weapon state. The tests led to international sanctions, especially from the United States. Operation Shakti remains a significant milestone in India's defense and scientific achievements.
